signin_no_browser: No browser to sign in with
error_auth: The server didn’t accept this email and password.
error_network: Can’t reach the server. Check the connection.
error_tls: Can’t set up a secure connection to the server.
error_server: The server replied with an error. Try again later.
error_storage: Can’t read the mail saved on this device.
error_gone: This message is no longer on the server. Refresh the inbox.
error_no_archive: This account has no Archive folder.
error_no_smtp: This account has no SMTP server, so it can’t send mail yet.
notify_more: More new mail is waiting in the inbox.
account_remove_text: Its mail is removed from this phone. The mailbox on the server stays as it is.
compose_quoted: The quote goes under your text
compose_forwarded: The forwarded message goes under your text
message_images_hidden: Images are hidden, so the sender can’t tell you opened this.
crash_text: Send the report to the author? The letter opens first, so you can read it. It holds where the app failed, the app and Android versions and the phone model. No mail.
signin_welcome: All your mail in one calm place.
signin_trust: Your mail stays on this phone. No tracking.
signin_found_text: Enter the password for this mail.
error_server_not_found: No server found for this address. Enter it below.
signin_gmail_text: If Google sign-in doesn’t let you in, an app password will: turn on 2-Step Verification in your Google Account, then make one.
signin_app_password_text: This service asks for an app password, not your usual one. Making one takes a minute.
error_no_trash: This account has no Trash folder.
inbox_undo_late: Too late to undo: the server already has it
swipes_tip: Swipe left: %1$s; right: %2$s. Change it in Settings → Swipes.
swipes_tip_lift: Drag the bottom bar up for mailboxes.
account_keep_hint: Older mail stays on the server, and search finds it.
inbox_reverted: The server refused some changes, so they were undone
inbox_signed_out_text: New mail waits until you do. Everything here stays.
signin_again_google: Google asks you to sign in to %1$s again. Your mail, folders and settings stay as they are.
signin_again_password: The server no longer accepts the password for %1$s. If you changed it, or it was an app password, enter the new one. Your mail and settings stay.
error_wrong_account: That is another Google account. Choose the one you are signing in to again.
attachment_not_saved: Can’t save the file. Check the free space.
attachment_no_app: No app on this phone opens this file.
attachment_cant_show: Can’t show this file here. Open it in another app.
crash_text_ios: Send the report to the author? The letter opens first, so you can read it. It holds where the app failed, the app and iOS versions and the phone model. No mail.
lake_loading_slow: Still loading. A big mailbox takes a minute the first time.
status_slow: Still checking. The connection is slow, so this takes longer.
status_background: This is taking long. The check goes on in the background.
status_offline: No connection. Showing mail saved on this phone. It checks again once you are online.
status_offline_account: No connection to %1$s. The other mailboxes are up to date.
signin_exchange_text: Work mail on the Exchange server your company runs. The server is found from your address; if it is not, enter it yourself.
error_certificate_unreadable: Can’t open the certificate. Check the file and its password.
error_no_server: No Exchange server found for this address. Enter it below: it is in your work mail settings, or your IT team knows it.
error_no_ews: This server doesn’t answer as Exchange. Check the address: it is in your work mail settings, or your IT team knows it.
error_certificate_needed: This server asks for a certificate from this device. Tap Add a certificate under the fields and pick your company’s one.
error_untrusted_certificate: This server’s certificate didn’t pass the checks. Trust it only if your IT team confirms the fingerprint below.
error_device_blocked: Your company’s server hasn’t let this phone in yet. Ask your IT team to allow Ozero Mail in Exchange ActiveSync, then try again.
compose_files_too_large: One message can carry up to 25 MB of files.
compose_file_unreadable: Can’t read this file. Try another one.
snooze_past: Pick a time later than now.
error_no_snoozed: The Snoozed folder isn’t ready yet. Pull to refresh and try again.
account_new_mail_every_hint: With the app closed, the phone checks about this often. Open, mail comes at once.
account_new_mail_manually_hint: Mail comes only while the app is open.
signature_hint: Goes under your mail from every account without a signature of its own. You can change it in each message.
account_signature_hint: Goes under mail from this account. Leave it empty to use the default signature.
error_no_spam: This account has no Spam folder.
inboxes_edit_hint: Switch an inbox off to leave it out of All inboxes.
folders_pin_hint: Hold a folder to pin it.
account_settings_hint: Hold an account in the list to open its settings.
unsubscribe_text: Mail from this list stops coming. What is already here stays.
notify_hint: A notification comes for new mail from people in the inbox. Notifications and Newsletters stay quiet.
reading_size_hint: Only the text of mail; the rest follows the system.
reading_sample: Have a look at the second version of the header, please. I think the title could be calmer.
images_ask_hint: Mail from people shows its images. Other mail asks first, so the sender can’t tell you opened it.
images_always_hint: Senders of newsletters can tell you opened their mail. Spam still asks.
invite_no_calendar: No calendar app on this phone
contacts_usage: Ozero Mail suggests people from your contacts as you type an address and shows their names as you saved them. Your contacts stay on the phone.
